newsitem.title: INDONESIA: BNI pays 13 rph dividend, sees Q1 net up.
newsitem.headline: BNI pays 13 rph dividend, sees Q1 net up.

text.p: Indonesia's PT Bank Negara Indonesia (BNI) said on Wednesday it would pay a dividend of 13 rupiah per share for 1996 and that it saw an improved first quarter net profit.

"The 13 rupiah dividend for 1996 should be seen in the context that the nominal share price is 500 rupiah and that we went public in late November last year," president director Widigdo Sukarman told reporters after a shareholders meeting.
Sukarman was responding to questions on why the dividend was relatively small.
The amount of dividend payment in 1995, before the state-owned bank went public, was not immediately available.

Director Nono Purnomo said there would be an improvement in the bank's first quarter net profit against net profit in the same period last year, but he did not give details. The figure is likely to be announced later this month.
BNI planned to boost its retail business by increasing the number of its automated teller machines to 500 units at the end of 1997 from 265 units at the end of 1996, Sukarman said.
Sukarman declined to reveal the state-owned bank's net profit forecast this year. The bank posted a net profit of 335 billion rupiah in 1996, or up 22.6 percent from 1995.

Sukarman said monetary authorities were planning to set up strong regional banks through mergers of some banks, but declined to comment on market talk of a possible merger between BNI and state-owned Bank Tabungan Negara.
